title: 第727章 蛋炒饭低山臭水第726章一壶酒共饮
slug: 玄幻真龙为骨我刀问天下
content_zh:
言罢，二戒扭头看向了墙头之上的陆去疾，一脸感慨道：“陆兄，我原以为咱俩这辈子只能做对手，没想到竟然还能并肩作战，缘分二字，果真奇妙无比。”
陆去疾嘴角扯了扯，笑道：“狗屁的缘分，要不是我给你写信，你能来？”
二戒微微一愣：“这倒是。”
他双手轻轻搭在膝上，看了一眼陆去疾：“不过……就算你不写信告诉我，我知道了也是要掺和一脚的。”
“哦？”陆去疾抬了抬眉头，“我怎么有些有些不信呢，你二戒是什么人我还不清楚？”
二戒一动不动的盯着陆去疾：
“小看我二戒了不是？”
“大是大非前，我二戒从来不怂。”
说着，他脸不红心不跳的吹嘘道：
“今朝斩妖十万众，明日佛陀应拜我。”
陆去疾笑了笑没说话，只是眺望着远方，不知道在想些什么。
见陆去疾没说话，二戒唇角微动，继续说道：“想当初要不是七戒，说不定，我也是侠客行的一员。”
陆去疾脸上流露出些许意外，瞥了一眼二戒，反问一声：“怎么？这么想与我共事？”
二戒没直接回答，而是意味深长的叹了一声：“毕竟那一锅蛋炒饭的味道，很合我胃口。”
陆去疾对着二戒吐槽道：“可别提了，我那侠客行就开张过一天，只有你一个客人，只卖出去过一碗蛋炒饭，怪让人郁闷的。”
二戒忽然哈哈大笑起来：
“为了还你一碗蛋炒饭，我当初可没少遭罪，差点命根子不保啊。”
陆去疾伸了个懒腰，随后跳下城头，一屁股坐在二戒旁边，“没有那一碗蛋炒饭，你以为小金刚寺能在江南立足？知足吧你。”
二戒挪了挪屁股，给陆去疾腾出了一个位置，对着他挤了挤眼睛，尴尬一笑：
“咱俩说这些做甚，生分了哈。”

陆去疾将一壶酒递到了二戒身前，问：
“你来，大衍法师没拦你？”
二戒接过酒坛子后如实回道：“拦了，但我还是来了。”
陆去疾沉吟了片刻，伸手在二戒的光头上摸了一把，称赞道：“金刚寺三千武僧，不及你二戒一人。”
二戒翻了翻白眼，骂骂咧咧道：
“你以为夸我几句就能光明正大的摸我的头？”
“要不是明日还要厮杀，我多少得和你干一架。”
陆去疾轻飘飘的瞥了一眼二戒，“你要不服，我现在也可以陪你练练。”
二戒眼神躲闪，整个人瞬间软了下去，但依旧嘴硬：“练练就不必了，佛爷我就不和你计较了，真要动起手来，你绝对不是我的对手。”
陆去疾摇了摇头，打趣道：“你这张嘴就是不吃亏，快比得上老王了。”
二戒瞥了一眼不远处的老王，上半身凑到陆去疾耳边，小声道：
“我可比不上他，我顶多调戏一下花魁，他可是连女妖都不放过。”
老王就站在不远处，听到二戒的话后立马转过身，赶忙纠正道：“二戒和尚，此言差矣，我王二虫泡妞从来不靠嘴，全靠一身的才华，以及一张普普通通的脸。”
content_en:
After saying that, Erjie turned to look at Lu Quji on the wall, and said with emotion: "Brother Lu, I thought we could only be rivals in this life, but I didn't expect that we could fight side by side. The word fate is really wonderful."
Lu Quji twitched the corner of his mouth and said with a smile: "What a bullshit fate. If I hadn't written to you, would you have come?"
Erjie was slightly startled: "That's true."
He gently put his hands on his knees and glanced at Lu Quji: "But...even if you don't tell me in a letter, I will still get involved if I find out."
"Oh?" Lu Quji raised his brows, "Why do I not believe it? I don't know who you Erjie is?"
Erjie stared at Lu Quji motionlessly:
"You're underestimating my second ring, aren't you?"
"I, Erjie, will never give up before big things happen."
As he spoke, he boasted without blushing:
"Today I will kill hundreds of thousands of demons, and tomorrow the Buddha will worship me."
Lu Quji smiled and said nothing. He just looked into the distance, not knowing what he was thinking.
Seeing that Lu Quji remained silent, Erjie's lips moved slightly and continued: "I think if it hadn't been for Qijie, maybe I would have been a member of the Knights."
Lu Quji's face showed some surprise. He glanced at Erjie and asked, "What? You want to work with me so much?"
Erjie did not answer directly, but sighed meaningfully: "After all, the taste of that pot of egg fried rice is very suitable to my appetite."
Lu Quji complained to Erjie: "Don't mention it. My Xia Ke store has only been open for one day. You are the only customer and we only sold one bowl of egg fried rice. It's really depressing."
Erjie suddenly burst out laughing:
"In order to repay you with a bowl of egg fried rice, I suffered a lot and almost lost my life."
Lu Quji stretched, then jumped off the city wall and sat down next to Erjie, "Without that bowl of egg fried rice, do you think Xiaojingang Temple can gain a foothold in Jiangnan? Just be satisfied."
Er Jie moved his buttocks to make a place for Lu Quji, winked at him and smiled awkwardly:
"We are so angry about what we are talking about."
Lu Quji handed a bottle of wine to Erjie and asked:
"Come here, Master Dayan didn't stop you?"
After Erjie took the wine jar, he replied truthfully: "You stopped me, but I'm still here."
Lu Quji pondered for a moment, reached out and touched Er Jie's bald head, and praised: "The three thousand monks in Jingang Temple are not as good as you, Er Jie, alone."
Erjie rolled his eyes and cursed:
"Do you think you can pat my head openly by praising me a few times?"
"If we didn't have to fight tomorrow, I would have to fight with you."
Lu Quji glanced at Erjie lightly and said, "If you are not convinced, I can practice with you now."
Erjie's eyes dodge, and his whole body instantly softened, but he still said harshly: "There's no need to practice, Buddha, I won't argue with you. If I really want to take action, you are definitely no match for me."
Lu Quji shook his head and joked: "You just don't suffer any loss with your mouth. You are almost as good as Lao Wang."
Erjie glanced at Lao Wang who was not far away, put his upper body close to Lu Quji's ear, and whispered:
"I can't compare to him. I can only tease the oiran, but he doesn't even let the banshee go."
Lao Wang was standing not far away. After hearing Erjie's words, he immediately turned around and hurriedly corrected him: "Monk Erjie, this is wrong. I, Wang Erchong, never rely on my words to pick up girls. I rely entirely on my talent and an ordinary face."
